messages:
Ivy Chen: Heads-up: IntegratorZ marketplace listing goes live June 14. Need final SI co-sell handshake before announce. Key asks: lead ownership window, SFDC field names, CSV export schema, and demo-credit policy.

Marc Dubois: Proposal: IntegratorZ owns inbound marketplace leads for 6 calendar days. If no outreach within 72h -> reminder ping. At day 6 -> auto-reassign to Redwood SDR. Exceptions for flagged high-intent accounts.

Sonal Kapoor: Agree but prefer 7d to account for weekends and time zones. Suggest: 48h confirmation requirement from SI after claim, and 7d auto-reassign if unconfirmed.

Ethan Reyes: For SFDC use these canonical fields: `lead_source=marketplace_integratorz`, `partner_id`, `partner_claimed_at`, `partner_confirmed_at`, `auto_reassign_at`, `high_intent_flag`. We'll wire automations off `auto_reassign_at`.

Marketplace Bot: Draft playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/integratorz-handshake (draft) :link:

Ivy Chen: Demo-credit policy: we give 3 demo credits per lead. IntegratorZ can consume credits if they own the lead. If lead transfers to Redwood, remaining credits revert to Redwood. Need this clearly in playbook.

Marc Dubois: IntegratorZ can emit usage webhooks (account_id, usage_pct, seats_active). We'll send sample payload today. High-intent rule: `usage_pct >= 45 OR seats_active >= 3 OR account_tier == "enterprise"`. If high-intent -> no auto-reassign.

Sonal Kapoor: Good. We also need CSV export schema for partner bulk claims. Suggested fields: `account_id`, `company_name`, `primary_contact_name`, `primary_contact_email`, `lead_created_at`, `lead_source`, `partner_id`, `claimed_at`, `status`, `trial_usage_pct`, `notes`.

Ethan Reyes: SFDC automation pseudocode in playbook:
```
on create:
  set lead_source = "marketplace_integratorz"
  set auto_reassign_at = created_at + 7d
on partner webhook usage event:
  if usage_pct >= 45 -> set high_intent_flag = true
on partner claim:
  set partner_claimed_at = now
  require partner_confirmed_at within 48h else escalate
  if high_intent_flag == true -> cancel auto_reassign
```

Ivy Chen: Who owns routing infra and Confluence updates? Marc owns partner webhook integration. Ethan owns SFDC flows. Sonal will update playbook and legal blurb.

Marketplace Bot: Jira created: PART-10011 integratorz-routing (assignee: Marc Dubois) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PART-10011

Marc Dubois: I'll post webhook sample by EOD and loop IntegratorZ eng.

Sonal Kapoor: I'll post the playbook update + privacy language and share for sign-off by Wed.

Ivy Chen: Final ask: marketing wants a single-sheet co-branded asset + email template. Marc, can IntegratorZ supply logos and brand guide?

Marc Dubois: Yes, assets arriving tomorrow. I'll drop into Confluence.

Ethan Reyes: No blockers from eng-ops. I'll create SFDC flow ticket and link it in the playbook.

Ivy Chen: Thanks team. I'll consolidate decisions and close the loop with marketing. Will post final approval here once Legal signs off. :rocket:
